semiconductor_relevance: High — ACDT provides critical cleanroom equipment essential for maintaining controlled environments in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Air Clean Deviser Taiwan Corp. specializes in the design and manufacturing of cleanroom equipment, including Fan Filter Units (FFUs) that are vital for semiconductor and other high-tech industries. Their products ensure high-quality air solutions and contamination control, supporting various cleanliness levels required in semiconductor fabrication.
